stories.title: Roads closed as firefighters tackle town centre blaze
stories.summary: About six crews are called to the three-storey building in Ipswich.

stories.title: Nine police staff face action over domestic murder
stories.summary: Five will face disciplinary hearings while four will undertake a practice review, says regulator.

stories.title: Rail bridge tops 'Britain's most bashed' list again
stories.summary: The A5 Watling Street railway bridge tops Network Rail's 2025-26 list with 26 strikes.

stories.title: Town centre Post Office reopens in new location
stories.summary: The branch has relocated after being forced to move out of its previous premises.

stories.title: Plans submitted for new roundabout on A-road
stories.summary: Developers claim a repurposed business park could create 1,600 jobs.

stories.title: McAteer 'intelligence' earns praise from Ipswich boss
stories.summary: Ipswich Town boss David Wright praised the football intelligence of Wales international Mary McAteer following her first goal for the club.

stories.title: Village sets date for referendum to 'leave UK'
stories.summary: The vote is in response to plans to house about 930 migrants at RAF Barnham.

stories.title: 'School site is putting children's lives at risk'
stories.summary: Suffolk County Council says Lakenheath school is safe to be open, "but lessons have been learned".

stories.title: Social media fuels race hate, says former EDL regional organiser
stories.summary: Ivan Humble, from Lowestoft, now works with young people to help them understand radicalisation.

stories.title: Experts explore returning beavers to River Waveney
stories.summary: A trust says the river-dwelling mammals could improve the health of the waterway.

stories.title: My busy life meant I delayed my smear test - then I got cancer
stories.summary: Laura Woods says she might not be here if she had delayed her smear test any longer.

stories.title: Dog finds God: Lance the Lab cross joins clergy
stories.summary: The three-year-old dog is made an honorary canine canon for enhancing the life of his blind owner.
